name: Fairphone B.V.
note: Amsterdam-based social enterprise founded in January 2013 by Bas van Abel, Tessa Wernink and Miquel Ballester; registered B Corporation since April 2015. In 2023 a consortium of impact investors led by Invest-NL and the ABN AMRO Sustainable Impact Fund, alongside existing shareholder Quadia (Regenero Impact Fund), invested 49 million euros. Private company; no state or fund control in the chain.
